D017-D016_h001.question:
It’s been… I don’t know, maybe six months or so that this has really started bothering me. Sometimes I’ll move the mirrors or avoid looking straight at myself, but other times I’ll lean in really close, checking from different angles. It doesn’t stop me from working, but it makes me distracted and anxious, like I’m constantly second‑guessing what people see when they look at me.
